en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a European river city with hills in the background. Several bridges cross the river; in the foreground is a metal truss bridge, and farther upstream two more bridges are visible, with a column-like monument standing in the river between them. On the right side stands a baroque-style church tower and dense old-town buildings. High on the hill to the right is a fortress complex. At the bottom margin, cursive text reads "Graz: Die 3 Brücken." On a riverside building a sign reads "JOS. S..." indicating a business name.
